title: Party Pros form E2E auth unblock live proof
lane: V2.8 Tenant Website / Pumpkin Live Platform Readiness
blockedReasons: Approved secure handoff did not include a non-empty readbackAuth.headerValue and PUMPKIN_FORMENTRY_READBACK_AUTH_VALUE was absent from the shell.
Starter live submit requires PUMPKIN_TENANT_ID and PUMPKIN_API_KEY, but the deployed starter app did not have them and the secure handoff submit key candidate was empty.
